title: Page 1
content_zh:
小男孩名叫苏劲沧，十岁。一般这个年纪正是爱玩的时候，他却和别人特别不一样。一整个下午就坐在自家书房的大皮椅上，翻阅着一本厚厚的历史小说。
他聪明早熟，学校的功课对他而言太简单了，不需要准备就可以一直保持全学年第一。于是他广泛的
就当他神游在历史事件的峰回路转之中，突兀的呼噜声却打断他的思绪。
微皱起眉，他的视线从书册转向一旁书桌上的大型物体。
那是个七岁的小女孩，微张着嘴，怀里抱着一只泰迪熊，趴在桌上睡着了。睡着不打紧，竟然还敢给他打呼。
苏劲沧的眉皱得更深了。
他这个年纪的男生有哪个喜欢跟个幼儿园小鬼在一起的，可是他怎么甩就是甩不开这个牛皮糖。
她是隔壁邻居的小孩，叫叶咏欢，跟他一样是独生子女。有一回这个笨蛋爬进庭院的水池里想要捡一颗球，差点把自己溺死，他只是恰巧看到，叫了人来帮忙，从此她就把他当成救命恩人。
是，他是她的救命恩人，可是对他来说，她却是个大麻烦。
最受不了的是，连双方的爸妈都跟着瞎起哄，说这家伙以后就归他管了，从那天之后，她就整天跟在他屁股后面跑。
他对小孩子没有耐心、从没给过她好脸色，更不会陪她玩，不过这些好像都赶不走她。
就像今天下午，她拖了一大箱玩具要他陪她玩办家家酒。
开玩笑！他会答应才怪。
「我要看书，别吵我，走开。」
大大的、黑黑的，像是小狗般的眼睛，原本那样充满希望的仰望着他，听到他那么说，一瞬间被失望所取代，变得低沉失落，没有了生气。
难以否认的，就算冷酷如他，心也小小的缩了一下，好像不答应她是多大的罪恶似的。
「这样啊……那我在这里陪你。」
「不要，妳回去。」
「不要、不要，让我待在这里，欢欢保证不吵哥哥。」
「……」

他真不知道这家伙干么要这么低声下气、诚惶诚恐的跟着他。她在自己家里不是个大小姐吗？别说佣人有好几个，就是专属的保母她爸妈也不是请不起。
「拜托～」小小的手合掌哀求。
又来了，她又用那种祈求的表情看他，真的很像小狗！
「随便妳，不过不可以吵我。」他不耐烦的挥挥手。
「我保证、我保证！绝对不会吵哥哥。」
保证个鬼！
相信她的他也是个笨蛋。
轻微的鼾声持续传来，他厌恶的看她一眼。
那棕色的头发绑了两个松松的蝴蝶结，雪白透红的脸颊就像是一颗苹果，她其实长得不差，不说话的时候，有点像是童话书里的小天使，只是那张开的粉红色嘴巴让她看起来就像个傻瓜一样，破坏了整个美感。
自己被她吵得不能看书，这家伙倒好了，睡得那么香。突然间，他心中的恶魔兴起欺负她的念头。
伸出两只手指，他掐住她的鼻子。
原本睡得舒服的小脸微微扭曲起来，然后那从来不曾皱过的眉心皱了起来，尽管还闭着眼睛，可是小小的脸庞却现出极度惊恐、难受的表情。
「哇！」
她骤然张开眼，眼底还有挥之不散的恐惧，失焦的双眼焦急的梭巡，在看见苏劲沧的时候才松了口气。
「怎么了？」苏劲沧明知故问。
小女孩拍着自己的胸膛，惊魂甫定的说：「哥哥，我告诉你喔！我作了一个很可怕的梦，我梦到大魔王掐住我的鼻子，不让我呼吸。」
苏劲沧听了直想笑，她却笨笨的笑了起来。
「呵，还好只是恶梦。」
「那妳现在还怕吗？」
「不怕，有哥哥在我身边，我什么都不怕！」她说得很肯定，还咧开大大的笑容。

这家伙！以后恐怕是那种被卖了还帮人数钱的那种笨蛋。
笨透了！
不知道为什么，也许是她那呆样让人就是很想欺负她，他有种欲罢不能的感觉。
「喂！把妳的小熊给我。」
那泰迪熊是她走到哪就要拎到哪，除了洗澡几乎不离身的宝贝。
「小、小熊？」她下意识抱得更紧，茫然的看他。
「对。」
「呃……哥哥你要小熊做什么？」
「我坐了一下午，屁股痛得不得了，妳那只熊刚好可以给我当椅垫。」
「啊？」
「给不给？」
他看出她的犹豫和不舍。连他都不确定她会不会交出来，毕竟他知道小熊对她的意义有多重大，可是如果她敢不给的话……哼哼！
颤抖的伸出手，她仍是把小熊交给了他。
「那……哥哥你要好好对待小熊喔！」
她还不放心的交代，可是苏劲沧一拿到手就不客气的把熊塞在屁股下面。
她惊恐的张大眼睛，想要说什么，可是看到他抬眉一副「妳有什么意见」的表情，她把话吞了进去。
委屈的扁起嘴，她缩着身子，看起来有种可怜兮兮的味道。
他的嘴角扬起一抹邪恶的笑。「怎么，小熊给我用妳很不甘愿？那还妳好了啊！」连他自己都没有想过自己是这么恶劣的人。不知怎么的，在师长亲友面前一向聪明有礼的他，一对上她，骨子里的劣根性就会毫不掩饰的显现。
「不、不用了。哥哥要就给哥哥好了。」
「哦？可妳不是很喜欢这只小熊？」

「嗯，我是很喜欢小熊，不过世界上我最喜欢的就是哥哥，所以哥哥想要什么，我都会给哥哥。」
她的话让他的心得到暖暖的满足，那是种轻飘飘的感觉，好像整个人都要飞起来似的。
被这种感觉冲昏头的他一时松懈，脱口而出。「很好。对了，妳刚刚说要玩办家家酒，我现在可以陪妳玩。」
「真的吗？」她像中了乐透似的狂喜，欢欣雀跃的去拿她的那些家家酒用具出来。
苏劲沧有点后悔让这家伙这么得意。
不过偶尔为之应该妨碍不大。
他这么安慰自己。
第1章(1)
男人的神情冷峻，犹如刀斧雕刻的脸庞覆上一层阴郁的寒冷。
他的视线停留在眼前的老屋，那是十年前他称之为家的地方。
曾经的白墙漆上了淡绿的色彩，记忆中的老树不知何时被砍掉了，留下光秃秃的一片水泥地板。这些转变在在提醒他—屋子已经换了主人，过去的时光也无法追回。
十年……
那是很长、很长的一段时间。
他生命中最美好、最无忧的二十年都在这里度过，那时他有一对人人称羡的恩爱父母，有显赫的家世，有等着他接班的家族企业。
他意气风发，觉得没有任何事情可以难倒自己，虽然才大学二年级，却已经规划好毕业后要赴美进修MBA，然后回来继承家业，把从事食品加工的家族事业扩大经营，延伸触角到新兴的电子产业。
他都想好了，只是人生并不是可以完全依照计划来走。
一次千面人的下毒事件把他家辛辛苦苦建立起来的饮料市场一夕间毁灭。下架、退货、彻查，这些动作耗掉公司的流动资金，一箱箱的退货摆在仓库、一批批的警察、媒体、卫生局人员的重复「关切」。
在那样的情况之下，没有银行愿意出手帮助。
那是他第一次了解到什么叫做人情冷暖。爸爸低声下气的请求那些常常陪着一起打球吃饭的朋友帮忙，得到的不是拒绝就是根本找不到人，那些过年、过节总是带着昂贵礼盒来登门拜访的人一个个都消失了。
content_en:
The little boy's name is Su Jincang, ten years old. Normally this is the time when you love to play, but he is very different from others. I spent the whole afternoon sitting on the big leather chair in my study, flipping through a thick historical novel.
He is smart and precocious, and schoolwork is too easy for him. He can stay first throughout the school year without preparation. So he widely
Just as he was wandering in the twists and turns of historical events, a sudden snoring interrupted his thoughts.
Frowning slightly, he turned his gaze from the book to the large object on the desk beside him.
It was a seven-year-old girl, with her mouth slightly open and a teddy bear in her arms, lying on the table and falling asleep. It didn't matter that he was asleep, but he still dared to snore him.
Su Jincang's frown deepened.
Which boy of his age would like to be with a kindergarten brat, but no matter how hard he tried to get rid of him, he just couldn't get rid of this sweetie.
She is the child of the next door neighbor, her name is Ye Yonghuan, and like him, she is an only child. Once this fool climbed into the pool in the courtyard to pick up a ball and almost drowned himself. He just happened to see it and called someone to help. From then on, she regarded him as her lifesaver.
Yes, he was her savior, but to him, she was a big trouble.
The most unbearable thing was that even the parents of both parties started making noises, saying that this guy would be under his control from now on. From that day on, she followed him around all day long.
He has no patience with children, never treats her well, and won't play with her, but none of this seems to drive her away.
Just like this afternoon, she dragged a large box of toys and asked him to play with her at the house wine.
joke! It's strange that he would agree.
"I want to read a book, don't disturb me and go away."
Her big, dark, puppy-like eyes were originally looking up at him full of hope. When she heard what he said, they were instantly replaced by disappointment, becoming depressed and lifeless.
It was undeniable that even though he was as cold as he was, his heart shrank slightly, as if not agreeing to her would be such a sin.
"That's it... then I'll stay here with you."
"No, you go back."
"No, no, let me stay here. Huanhuan promises not to disturb my brother."
"..."
He really didn't know why this guy wanted to follow him in such a humble and fearful manner. Isn't she the eldest lady in her own family? Not to mention there are several servants, even her parents can't afford a dedicated nanny.
"Please~" the little girl begged with her hands clasped together.
Here it comes again, she looks at him again with that pleading expression, it really looks like a puppy!
"Whatever you want, but don't disturb me." He waved his hand impatiently.
"I promise, I promise! I will never quarrel with you, brother."
Guaranteed!
He was also a fool for believing her.
Slight snoring continued, and he gave her a disgusted look.
Her brown hair was tied with two loose bows, and her snow-white and rosy cheeks were like an apple. She actually looked pretty good. When she wasn't talking, she looked a bit like a little angel in a fairy tale book. But her open pink mouth made her look like a fool, ruining the entire beauty.
I was so disturbed by her that I couldn't read, but this guy was fine and slept so soundly. Suddenly, the devil in his heart aroused the idea of ​​bullying her.
He stretched out two fingers and pinched her nose.
The little face that had been sleeping comfortably was slightly distorted, and then the eyebrows that had never frowned wrinkled. Although the eyes were still closed, the little face showed an expression of extreme fear and discomfort.
"Wow!"
She suddenly opened her eyes, with lingering fear in her eyes. Her unfocused eyes anxiously darted around, and she breathed a sigh of relief when she saw Su Jincang.
"What's wrong?" Su Jincang asked knowingly.
The little girl patted her chest and said in shock: "Brother, let me tell you! I had a very terrible dream.I dreamed that the devil pinched my nose and prevented me from breathing. "
Su Jincang wanted to laugh after hearing this, but she laughed stupidly.
"Oh, luckily it was just a nightmare."
"Are you still afraid now?"
"I'm not afraid. With my brother by my side, I'm not afraid of anything!" She said with certainty and a big smile.
This guy! In the future, I'm afraid I will be the kind of fool who helps count money after being sold.
So stupid!
He didn't know why, maybe it was because she was so stupid that he just wanted to bully her, and he felt like he couldn't stop.
"Hey! Give me your little bear."
The teddy bear is a treasure that she carries everywhere she goes and rarely leaves her body except when taking a bath.
"Little, little bear?" She subconsciously hugged him tighter and looked at him blankly.
"Yes."
"Uh...brother, what do you want Little Bear to do?"
"I've been sitting all afternoon and my butt hurts so much. Your bear can be used as a chair cushion for me."
"Huh?"
"Will you give it or not?"
He saw her hesitation and reluctance. Even he was not sure whether she would hand it over. After all, he knew how much the bear meant to her, but if she dared not to give it to her... Humph!
Stretching out her hand tremblingly, she still handed the bear to him.
"Then...brother, you have to treat the little bear well!"
She confessed without worry, but as soon as Su Jincang got his hands on it, he stuffed the bear under his butt politely.
She opened her eyes in horror and wanted to say something, but when she saw him raising his eyebrows with a "what do you think" expression, she swallowed the words.
She pursed her lips in grievance and huddled up, looking pitiful.
An evil smile spread across his lips. "Why, you're not willing to let me use Little Bear? That's better for you!" Even he himself had never thought that he was such a bad person. Somehow, he was always smart and polite in front of his teachers, relatives and friends, but once he got to know her, his bad nature would be revealed unabashedly.
"No, no need. Just give it to me if you want it."
"Oh? But you don't like this little bear very much?"
"Well, I like little bears very much, but my favorite in the world is my brother, so I will give him whatever he wants."
Her words made his heart feel warm and satisfied. It was a light and airy feeling, as if his whole body was about to fly.
Dazzled by this feeling, he relaxed for a moment and blurted out. "Very good. By the way, you just said you wanted to play host family wine, I can play with you now."
"Really?" She was as ecstatic as if she had won the lottery, and happily went to get her drinking utensils.
Su Jincang regretted making this guy so proud.
But it shouldn't be much of a hindrance occasionally.
He comforted himself like this.
Chapter 1(1)
The man's expression was stern, like a face carved with a knife and ax covered with a layer of gloomy coldness.
His eyes stayed on the old house in front of him, the place he called home ten years ago.
The once white walls were painted a light green color, and the old trees in my memory were chopped down at some point, leaving a bare concrete floor. These changes reminded him that the house had changed owners, and the past time could not be recovered.
Ten years...
That was a long, long time.
The best and most worry-free twenty years of his life were spent here. At that time, he had a pair of loving parents that everyone admired, a prominent family background, and a family business waiting for him to take over.
He is high-spirited and feels that nothing can hinder him. Although he is only in his second year of college, he has already planned to go to the United States to study for an MBA after graduation, and then come back to inherit the family business, expand the family business in food processing, and extend his reach into the emerging electronics industry.
He has thought about it all, but life doesn't always go according to plan.
A poisoning incident by a man with a thousand faces destroyed the beverage market that his family had worked so hard to build overnight.Removal from shelves, returns, and thorough inspections consume the company's working capital. Boxes of returns are placed in the warehouse, and batches of police, media, and health bureau personnel are repeatedly "concerned."
In such a situation, no bank is willing to help.
That was the first time he understood what warmth and coldness were in human relationships. Dad humbly asked for help from friends who often played games and had meals with him, but he either refused or couldn't find anyone at all. Those who always came to visit with expensive gift boxes during New Year and holidays disappeared one by one.
